title: UG-043 — How the EUSurvey editor workspace is organised
intent: Provide a concise overview of the five main editor areas for survey managers.
short_answer: The editor workspace contains five main areas: Navigation pane, Toolbox pane, Form area, Element properties pane and Toolbar. Together, these areas let form managers structure the questionnaire, add elements, preview them, edit settings and perform basic editing tasks.
important_conditions: This article is intended as a richer replacement for broad editor overview content and avoids repeating basic login or survey creation guidance.
